name: Active learning for conditional crystal inverse design
one_liner: A crystal generator proposes alloys with a target stiffness, a three-stage screen checks them up to DFT, and verified structures retrain it.

loop.proposes: Alloy crystal structures from Con-CDVAE conditioned on a target bulk modulus
loop.judged_by: Three screens: a CGCNN pre-filter, molecular dynamics with MACE-MP-0 (within 20%, stable), then DFT
loop.steers: Structures passing DFT, with computed bulk moduli, join the training set and the generator is fine-tuned

headline_result: For a 350 GPa bulk modulus target, in a range sparse in the training data, three active learning iterations lowered the mean absolute percentage error of generated crystals from about 0.4 to 0.2 (CGCNN-evaluated). DFT bulk moduli of new structures averaged 343.54 GPa (standard deviation 27.20) after the first iteration and 356.52 GPa (standard deviation 18.61) after the second.
caveat: The error trend is measured with the same kind of GNN used in the screen, and DFT is a calculation rather than a lab result. It is a case study on one property (bulk modulus) of alloys, and no structure was synthesized.
beyond_harness_note: A crystal VAE (not an LLM) is retrained on structures that a DFT-backed screening pipeline accepted.
generative_model: Con-CDVAE conditional crystal variational autoencoder, fine-tuned each iteration
algorithmic_authority: CGCNN pre-filter, MACE-MP-0 molecular dynamics, DFT (via APEX workflows)

sources.title: Active Learning for Conditional Inverse Design with Crystal Generation and Foundation Atomic Models (arXiv:2502.16984)

verification.notes: arXiv id resolves to the claimed title (Li, Liu, Ye, Srolovitz, Wen; HKU; submitted 24 Feb 2025). Read the full PDF text. Report corrections: the paper says 'alloy' crystals specifically; the bulk-modulus accuracy is judged by CGCNN, with DFT used for validation and training labels; MD uses MACE-MP-0 in LAMMPS. The MAPE 0.4 to 0.2 is the paper's phrase for the average; a separate 0.14 value is quoted for the 350 GPa condition at Iter2. It is a preprint (no venue shown).
